title: H3187 (122nd General Assembly): Unlawful carrying of handguns

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2016-12-15; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess122_2017-2018/prever/3187_20161215.htm (LegiScan doc 1439444))
provenance.note: Introduced text, 2016-12-15. Only new item (17) is changed; items (1)-(16) are existing law (item 15 and 16 punctuation only).

operative_text:
Section 1 (Section 16-23-20): It is unlawful for anyone to carry about the person any handgun, whether concealed or not, except as follows, unless otherwise specifically prohibited by law:
Section 1 (Section 16-23-20): (17) emergency medical services providers, firefighters, or other first responders who are engaged in examining, treating, or directing persons during an emergency and who are authorized to carry a concealed weapon pursuant to Article 4, Chapter 31, Title 23, or who have completed the same training as law enforcement officers in this State.
